test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'WINTER' is coded as XJXQKX and 'AUTUMN' is coded as TRYWWB. How will 'SEASON' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Number series is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series diagonally.

So,

 
• 'WINTER' is coded as XJXQKX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a38bdda3a10798ef042f2fa3e231517205ce45c54e8f2374aa12052d157cfe77.png] 

And,

 
• 'AUTUMN' is coded as TRYWWB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/957b588f966517a5f32690fa1e1d729c6b4a52200b4882835eaf0b2b287b2429.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'SEASON' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67232d7e1c6f019f6650bc12c73d4815520c8e34312d98a0afa191fed0a1acc7.png] 

​Hence, "**TTWDGT**" is the correct answer.
